title: Quietly Silky Moroccan Potatoes Zaalouk
description: A salty, silky, and nostalgic Moroccan dish featuring charlotte potatoes, nimono-simmer, and high-protein-friendly ingredients, formed into a traditional zaalouk.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced potatoes, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are slightly tender.
Add the chickpeas, tomato paste, and water, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the zaalouk hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
